name: @prism3/web-components
description: Prism3 components as Lit custom elements in the light DOM, rendering @prism3/css's markup and styled only by its CSS.

scripts.generate: npx tsx generate.ts && npm run manifest
scripts.check:generated: npx tsx generate.ts --check && npx tsx check-manifest.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run -w @prism3/tokens build && npx tsx check-browser.ts
